overview.mechanism: Provides a specified electrolyte and buffer composition for use with the prescribed extracorporeal kidney-replacement modality; products may serve as dialysate or replacement fluid only where their labeling permits.
uses: Kidney-replacement therapy using the exact formulation and equipment-compatible route specified by the product insert.

paragraphs.text: The PRISMASOL/PHOXILLUM reference label describes multiple formulations, including differences in potassium, calcium, bicarbonate and phosphate. These differences are clinically relevant and cannot be inferred from the generic heading.

Two-compartment reference bags require mixing before use. Choice of formulation and treatment must be individualized to fluid balance, electrolytes, acid–base status and glucose; not every brand or presentation is identical to the reference products.

An effluent-dose prescription is not the same as a drug dose or a direct replacement-fluid infusion rate. The registry heading alone cannot specify a CRRT protocol or whether a fluid is compatible with regional citrate anticoagulation.
